svg.title: Reachable everywhere is not governed everywhere
svg.desc: One website, owned in Ontario, Canada, loads in every country. Canadian law applies because the owner is there. US advertising law applies because the site markets to US clients. The EU AI Act's Article 50 likely applies because EU visitors see an AI-generated video. The EU GDPR and cookie rules are not triggered, because the site neither offers services to the EU nor tracks visitors; one tracking pixel would change that.

g.text: THE SITE MARKETS TO US CLIENTS
AI VIDEO SEEN BY EU VISITORS
